Fresh core and card checks pass. Deduction for target/comparison claim precision and bounded qualification breadth.

Typed bounded model stages, guarded responses and deterministic fallback, durable inquiry/events, actual two-model reviewer recording, scoped fleet connector, integrated voice/playback and current canonical TTS. Demonstrated reviewers select bounded suggestion enums; human-reviewed customer quality and current waveform/comprehension acceptance remain limited. Larger fleet execution is treated as a separate scope.

Substantive bronze/silver/gold pipeline with lineage, typed contracts/quarantine, deterministic deduplication, ownership enforcement, consumer outputs, immutable publication and writer locking; fixtures exercise corrections/late arrivals/failed builds. Historical six-table aggregates reconcile. Remaining limits are ETag/inventory freshness without VersionId-pinned ingestion and operator-only snapshot cleanup.

Correctly rejects template leakage and unlearnable labels; fixed train-only classifier/keyword/abstention comparison with frozen independent AI-authored holdout, errors/slices/uncertainty. Luna records audit to 100/100 and tie a deterministic baseline. Human adjudication required by the holdout's own final-submission gate remains pending; authored examples and ten repeated Luna phrases limit generalization/quality claims.

Read-only privacy-preserving metadata and exact current-host admission checks separate plans, receipts, recovery, cancellations and revocation. Operating analysis produces useful decisions from ownership/template defects, paired routing, handoff burden, token/cache overhead and latency. Missing exact turn/query attribution, persistent workflow token/cost data and card/lifetime outcome aggregation limit completeness; measured ROI is not claimed or required.

overall: Strong complete fictional-bank hackathon submission with deterministic core, implemented conversational enhancements, expandable generic/domain architecture and inspectable evidence. Not assessed as production banking certification.
